mapper.select: SELECT id, underpass_id, camera_role, stream_url, distance_m, latitude, longitude, created_at FROM underpass_camera WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, underpass_id, camera_role, stream_url, distance_m, latitude, longitude, created_at FROM underpass_camera WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO underpass_camera (underpass_id, camera_role, stream_url, distance_m, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{underpassId}, #{cameraRole}, #{streamUrl}, #{distanceM}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
mapper.update: UPDATE underpass_camera SET camera_role = #{cameraRole}, stream_url = #{streamUrl}, distance_m = #{distanceM}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
